findings: ManagedPairCounts find_slot only receives initially length2 or checked doubled buffer, nonempty power-of-two invariant precedes len-1. Empty/zero-limit table refuses before allocation; repeated existing keys use checked count increment.
reserve_slot refuses len>=limit; only reserves at len==capacity and target doubles saturating, clamps to limit, both exceed len for feasible growth, so next-len nonnegative.
Projective sampler rejects points.len<4 before i0..3 subtraction; enumerated remaining point bound and inlier count bound keep subtraction and sum within slice length.
MemoryBudget buffer byte multiplication is checked, credit reserved before Vec allocation and actual capacity reconciled before initialization.
